question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.

Macaroni penguins have a distenctive yellow feather crest on their forehead.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e.** 'distinctive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence *"Macaroni penguins have a distinctive yellow feather crest on their forehead*." contains a spelling error. 
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in this sentence is **'distenctive'.**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'distinctive', **which in Hindi is known as 'विशेष'.
 
• For example, She has a distinctive laugh.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is - 'Option 2' i.e**. 'distinctive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Forhead (option 1) in Hindi means ('मस्तक'). However, the correct spelling is 'forehead'.
 
• Penguens (option 3) in Hindi means ('पेंगुइन'). However, the correct spelling is 'penguins'.
 
• Chrest (option 4) in Hindi means ('चोटी'). However, the correct spelling is 'crest'.
